entries.german:
Burg Friedberg: Bestätigung des Rezesses von 1667 März 27

Formalbeschreibung: Ausf., Papierlibell in Perg.umschlag (50 Blatt) anh. Sg. in Holzkapsel gut erh. [im Anhang Abschr. von B8 Nr. 7/17 Bl. 11-48v))

(Vor-) Provenienzen: v. Rosenbach
entries.english:
Friedberg Castle: confirmation of the settlement dated 27 March 1667

Formal description: Original, paper booklet in a parchment cover (50 leaves), attached seal in a wooden case, well preserved [appendix contains a copy of B8 no. 7/17, fols. 11–48v]

Sealer: issuer

Previous provenance(s): von Rosenbach
